title: Ayushman Bharat – Arogya Karnataka (AB-ArK) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Integrated Karnataka government health assurance system combining state health protection with PM-JAY for eligible beneficiaries.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on Karnataka's current beneficiary classification and PM-JAY/state rules; resident and category documentation may be required.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Ayushman Bharat – Arogya Karnataka (AB-ArK).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
